pages.text: Inserts a value into an array.$(br2)The following elements move up by one. $(1)index$() must be between 0 and the length of the array, otherwise INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS is raised. Use the length to add the value at the end.

$(li)$(1)array$() ARRAY: the array$(li)$(1)index$() INTEGER: the position of the new element$(li)$(1)value$() the type of the elements: the value to insert$(li)result $(1)result$() like $(1)array$(): the array with the new element
$(1)CALL INSERT$(br)  PARAMETER array list ;$(br)  PARAMETER index 0 ;$(br)  PARAMETER value 42 ;$(br)  RESULT result list$()
